title: WebGL2 - OffscreenCanvas getContext('webgl2')
product-requirement: Terminals MUST implement WebGL v2 and permit obtaining WebGL2RenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas
specification: Terminals MUST implement WebGL v2 and permit a visible BBC application (main thread) to obtain WebGL2RenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas object's getContext API ('webgl2' context identifier)
assertion: OffscreenCanvas.getContext('webgl2') returns a valid WebGL2RenderingContext on the main thread

changelog.summary: Initial creation of WebGL2 context test for OffscreenCanvas (main thread)
